Pizza Bread
By: Alejandro Duarte
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 3:24am

Ingredients




1 loaf Bridgeford frozen bread dough
cup Mozzarella cheese, shredded
1 pkt salami, (3 ½ oz.) chopped
1 pkt pepperoni, (3 oz.) chopped

Preparation

1 Let dough rise 5-8 hours in greased pan. Roll dough into 6x8-inch rectangle. Place cheese and meats in center and fold like an enchilada. 2 Pinch dough together and put seam down on cookie sheet. Cut 4 vents on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes until golden brown. 3 Irene Foley
